items.title: Conservative climate policy blueprint under scrutiny after net-zero cost error emerges
items.summary: The Conservative Party’s shadow chancellor has announced plans to scrap a series of environmental and net-zero policies, including the Future Homes Standard and the Climate Change Act, as part of a wider programme of economic deregulation.

items.title: England suffers worst harvest on record after extreme summer weather
items.summary: New data from the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra) has revealed that England suffered its worst cereals and oilseed harvest since 1984 this year.

items.title: TWO WEEKS TO GO: How AI can accelerate investment in climate solutions
items.summary: With just two weeks to go, sustainability professionals are invited to register for an upcoming edie webinar exploring how artificial intelligence (AI), market intelligence and human expertise can help businesses identify credible climate investment opportunities and secure the financial backing needed to turn sustainability ambitions into action.

items.title: Low-carbon transitional sectors prone to increased greenwashing risks, research finds
items.summary: The transition to a low-carbon economy is creating new greenwashing risks across a more diverse set of sectors, with links to misleading claims up 28% year on year.

items.title: ON TUESDAY: Connecting existing sustainability reporting with UK SRS
items.summary: Taking place on Tuesday 13 October, this webinar will explore how businesses can connect existing ESOS, SECR and TCFD-aligned processes with emerging UK Sustainability Reporting Standards (UK SRS).

items.title: SPEAKERS ANNOUNCED: What SMEs need to know before investing in solar
items.summary: Two expert speakers have been confirmed for an upcoming edie webinar exploring how SMEs can overcome the financial and practical barriers to onsite solar and maximise the return on their investment.

items.title: Factcheck: UK Conservatives double the ‘cost of net-zero’ after spreadsheet blunder
items.summary: A booklet published by the UK’s opposition Conservative party includes a “cost of net-zero” that appears to have been doubled by a spreadsheet error.

items.title: Reactive vs proactive: Is sustainability stuck in defence mode?
items.summary: Despite the fact that climate risks are on the rise and proving increasingly disruptive for companies, on the whole, businesses still prioritise firefighting over more forward-looking measures, new research has found.

items.title: The UK's new ISSB-based sustainability reporting rules for listed companies
items.summary: This blog was originally published on 3 February 2026 and updated on 8 October 2026.

items.title: Wildlife populations have dropped 73% since 1970, WWF finds
items.summary: Although populations have fallen over 70% since 1970, the WWF has highlighted that transforming the world's energy, food and finance sectors would be instrumental in restoring biodiversity.
